summary: Frontend-only review of the tightened TwoViews dual-view section. Both panels render exactly 480px tall and pixel-aligned. All structural/styling specs verified except one: kanban card heights exceed the explicit 80px ceiling (max observed 96.2px), because most card titles wrap to two lines at 11px/1.35 line-height plus 8px+8px vertical padding.

ui_bugs.issue: Card heights exceed the 80px ceiling stated in the spec. Measured heights: TO DO cards 96.2px x2, IN PROGRESS cards 96.2px x3, DONE cards 91.7px x4. Required: <= 80px. Root cause: most card titles ('Build contact form with validation', 'Services page — layout, icons, pricing section', 'Mobile responsiveness pass — all breakpoints', 'Client feedback round 2 — homepage revisions', 'Final copywriting review and SEO meta tags', 'Logo variations and brand colour palette', 'Brand guidelines and asset handoff') wrap to 2 lines at fontSize 11px / line-height 1.35. With 8px+8px vertical padding, 5px title marginTop, 6px footer marginTop, plus ~12px tag row + ~14px footer row + 30px two-line title => ~83-96px.

action_items: Reduce KanbanCard height to <=80px. Options: (a) lower title line-height from 1.35 to ~1.2 and reduce vertical padding to 6px top/bottom, (b) clamp title to 1 line with text-overflow ellipsis, (c) shorten card title strings so they fit one line at the rendered column width (~210px). Today most titles wrap to 2 lines, busting the cap.
critical_code_review_comments: SubtaskBar component still defined in Landing.jsx (lines 927-958) but no longer rendered anywhere. Dead code — safe to delete.
KanbanCard inline onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave duplicate the same translateY/border logic; could be replaced with a CSS :hover rule for a single source of truth.
Landing.jsx is 1713 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting TwoViews/ClientKanban/KanbanCard/KanbanColumn into a separate module.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All TwoViews section measurements were taken via Playwright bounding_box() at viewport 1920x4000 after applying classList.add('in','go') on .r/.split/.story-bar to skip entry animation. The single failing spec is KanbanCard height: requirement says <=80px, observed 91.7-96.2px because card titles wrap to 2 lines. After main-agent fix, only need to re-measure card_heights — all other numeric specs already pass. Hover transforms must be tested using page.mouse.move(...) over the card center plus 800-900ms wait (Playwright element.hover() may not always fire mouseenter for these elements; the inline-style read confirms the actual values).
rca_of_the_issue: Bug: kanban cards render 91.7-96.2px tall, exceeding the 80px requirement. Reproduction: open landing, scroll to /DUAL VIEW, inspect any [data-hover] card. Cause: card titles like 'Build contact form with validation' wrap to 2 lines at fontSize 11px line-height 1.35 (~30px) + 8px top/bottom padding + ~12px category row + 5px margin + 6px margin + ~14px footer row = ~83-96px. Mitigation: tighten line-height to 1.2 and padding to 6px, or single-line clamp the title with overflow:hidden text-overflow:ellipsis whiteSpace:nowrap, or shorten the title strings so they fit on one line at ~210px column width.
